preregistered_outcomes.REAL_MECHANISM_VALIDATION_STRONG: At least two major mechanism families show stable qualitative corroboration.
preregistered_outcomes.REAL_MECHANISM_VALIDATION_PARTIAL: One family is corroborated, or additional families are noisy/incomplete.
preregistered_outcomes.REAL_MECHANISM_VALIDATION_NO_GO: Mechanisms do not reproduce or implementation fidelity is inadequate.
